title: Arrest Of A Foreigner At Quinsan

Date June 21, 1931.

Subject (in full) Arrest of a foreigner at Quinsan

Made by D.S.I. Pan Lien-pih Forwarded by Henry Robertson C.S.I.
Translated by D.I. Sih Ts-liang

At 9.30 a.m. June 9, the undersigned accompanied
H.B.M. Vice Consul Mr. Scott to Soochow. At 2 p.m. we inter-
viewed the City Magistrate of Soochow named Huang Yung Sung
(黄蕴深) in his Yamen, who stated that an instruction had been
received from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs ordering the
Bureau of Public Safety and Regimental Headquarters of the 2nd
Regiment of the Military Police to investigate and report regard-
ing the arrest of a foreigner, etc., and promised to convey to us
any information received from the investigating officer.

On the morning of June 10, we called at the Zui Ying
(萃英) Middle School, at Loh San Wan (六三湾) outside the
Chong Meng Gate, and interviewed Miss Comp, an American teacher
of the school. Through the amah of Miss Comp, Chang Keng Pao
(張根宝), a worker of the Chang Yung-tai Paper Box Shop
(opposite to the School) and his wife named Chang Yuen Dz were
summoned to the school. They stated that at between 3 or 4 p.m.
about 6 or 7 days ago, some 12 or 14 military Police having a
foreign youth from the Railway Station in their custody, passed
their shop en route to the Headquarters of the 1st Regiment of
the Military Police at Lau Ng Tuan, upper Sing Jiao, Soochow.
They identified the photograph which Vice Consul Mr. Scott shewed
them as that of the foreign youth in question.

Later, a laundry woman, on being interrogated, stated
that she overheard whilst chatting among soldiers when she was
collecting clothing at the Regimental Headquarters, that after
arrival there, a company commander had kicked the foreign youth
twice with his foot, and that on the foreign youth, who became
angry, returning the kick, the company commander stabbed him in
the neck with his bayonet.

事由（全称） 在昆山逮捕一名外国人

由 副督察长 潘连璧 制作 经由 亨利·罗伯逊 首席副督察长 转呈

6月9日上午9时30分，具名者陪同英国驻苏州副领事斯科特先生前往苏州。下午2时，我们在衙门会见了苏州地方法官黄蕴深（Huang Yung Sung），他表示已收到外交部指令，要求公安局和宪兵第二团团部就逮捕一名外国人等事进行调查并报告，并承诺将向我们要传达从调查官员处收到的任何信息。

6月10日上午，我们前往崇门（Chong Meng Gate）外六三湾（Loh San Wan）的萃英（Zui Ying）中学，会见了该校美籍教师康普小姐（Miss Comp）。通过康普小姐的女佣张根宝（Chang Keng Pao），传唤了昌永泰纸盒店（位于学校对面）的一名工人及其妻子张元氏（Chang Yuen Dz）。他们陈述说，大约6或7天前的下午3点至4点之间，约有12至14名宪兵押解着一名外国青年从火车站经过他们的店铺，前往苏州新桥（Sing Jiao）上浪五团（Lau Ng Tuan）的宪兵第一团总部。他们指认副领事斯科特先生出示的照片即为该涉事外国青年。

随后，一名洗衣妇在接受讯问时表示，她在团部收取衣物时，无意中听到士兵们闲聊说，那名外国青年到达那里后，一名连长用脚踢了他两次，当愤怒的外国青年回踢时，该连长用刺刀刺伤了他的颈部。

According to the No.1 Boy of the Railway Hotel, named
Huang Ping-sung (汪炳生), a fellow worker told him that about
one week ago a foreign youth under the escort of over 10
Military Police was seen coming from the railway station,
en route to the 1st Regimental Headquarters, of the Military
Police, Lau Ng Tuan, Upper Sing Jiao, via Ting Ka Hong.
Despite exhaustive enquiries among the station staff
and railway police at Soochow, nothing could be elicited
in connection with the case.
At 2.10 p.m. June 10 we proceeded to Quinsan and called
at the City Magistrate's Yamen. We were received by Secretary
Wong (王) who made the following statement : - On the
receipt of information regarding the shooting and wounding
of military police by bandit and the subsequent arrest of one
bandit, representatives were sent to the Military Police
Battalion Headquarters, but the latter, however, refused to
divulge any information on the condition that this matter
which concerned Military should be kept strictly confidential.
Several visits were made by the City Magistrate personally to
the Battalion Headquarters and the former interviewed the
Battalion Commander who however refused to state anything.
Consequently a reply was sent to that effect to the order
received from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs three days ago
ordering investigation into the case.
Subsequently we called at the 1st Section of the Public
Safety Bureau of Quinsan, and interviewed the Police Constable
Yeu Loo Li (尤樂禮). He stated that at 1 p.m. June 2, he
actually saw a foreign youth wearing dark-blue trousers with
red stripes board the train under the escort of about 10

据铁路饭店的一号侍役汪炳生（Huang Ping-sung）称，一名同事告诉他，大约一周前，有人看到一名外国青年在十多名宪兵的护送下，从火车站出发，经丁家巷（Ting Ka Hong），前往新桥（Upper Sing Jiao）浪五团（Lau Ng Tuan）的宪兵第一团总部。
尽管在苏州向车站工作人员和铁路警察进行了详尽查询，但未能获得与该案有关的任何线索。
6月10日下午2时10分，我们前往昆山，并拜访了县公署。我们受到王秘书（Secretary Wong）的接待，他作了如下陈述：在收到关于匪徒枪击并致伤宪兵以及随后逮捕一名匪徒的情报后，曾派代表前往宪兵营部，但后者以此事涉及军方需严格保密为由，拒绝透露任何信息。县长亲自多次前往营部，并会见了营长，但营长拒绝发表任何言论。因此，三天前收到外交部要求调查此案的命令后，已就此情况作了回复。
随后，我们前往昆山县公安局第一分局，会见了警员尤乐礼（Yeu Loo Li）。他表示，6月2日下午1时，他确实看到一名身穿带红条纹深蓝色长裤的外国青年，在约10名

    Subsequently we went to the headquarters of the 2nd
Regiment of the Military Police at Sung Ka Temple, Lien
Yuen Garden ( 留園 ), and interviewed the Commander King
Teh-yang ( 金德洋 ), who stated that they heard nothing as
their duties were confined to that portion of the railway
between Wusieh and Changchow while the portion between
Quinsan and Soochow was within the jurisdiction of the 1st
Regiment.
    On the 13th, the City Magistrate of Soochow, Huang Yung
Sung informed us by telephone that he had received replies
from the 1st and 2nd Regiments of the Military Police which
conveyed the same information as that obtained by us during
our visit at their respective headquarters. Acting at our
request the City Magistrate asked Col. Huang Tsung-ngoo of
the 1st Regiment for the sergeant named Hsia Jui-song ( 谢如松 )
attached to the 4th Company of the 1st Battalion ( He was the
officer-in-charge of the group of Military Police who were
patrolling when fired at by the bandit ). Later City Magistrate
Huang telephoned to state that according to Col. Huang , the
unit to which Sergeant Hsia was attached had left for Nanchang,
Kiangsi.

Subject (in full) Arrest of foreigner at Chen-i

Made by // and Forwarded by C.D.I. Robertson

Further to attached report on the above subject
I have t state that Mr. Curtis summoned Li Ah-chao to
Shanghai by express letter on the evening of June 17. This
information was conveyed to Mr. Blackburn who expressed a
desire to have Li Ah-chao on arrival taken to his office
as he wishes to interrogate him personally.
With reference to the statement made to Mr. Thorburn
by an amah named Sung Ah-mei (沈阿妹) in his employ re
her having seen Mr. John Thorburn in Shanghai on June 16
this woman was interrogated by the undersigned at 11.15
a.m. June 18 and the followin is a gist of a statement
made by her.
"On June 16 at 4.30 p.m. I was walking along Avenue
Joffre and on turning into Route de Boissezon I saw a
foreigner dressed in a brown suit and white sun helmet,
riding in a ricsha coming towards me. As the foreigner
approached me he covered the lower half of his face with
a white handkerchief and looking more closely at him
I found he was my young master. The ricsha continued on
its way and turned into Route Ferguson where I lost sight
of it. I then reported the matter to Mr. Thorburn."
The Amah's story was conveyed by Mr. Thorburn to Mr.
Blackburn who attached little importance to it and although
the amah holds to her statement I am inclined to believe
it is purely imagination.
In connection with the disappearance of John Thorburn
it has been ascertained that the French Police on June 18
sent a Chinese detective who has influential connections
in Soochow to the latter city with a view to tracing the

继上述事由的附件报告之后，
我谨陈述，柯蒂斯先生于6月17日晚通过快信将李阿召（Li Ah-chao）召至上海。此信息已告知布莱克本先生，他表示希望李阿召抵达后被带到他的办公室，因为他希望亲自审问他。
关于受雇于索伯恩先生的女佣沈阿妹（Sung Ah-mei）向索伯恩先生所作的陈述，称她于6月16日在上海见过约翰·索伯恩先生一事，具名者于6月18日上午11时15分对该女子进行了讯问，以下是其陈述的要点。
“6月16日下午4时30分，我正沿着霞飞路行走，转入贝赛隆路（Route de Boissezon）时，看见一名身穿棕色西装、头戴白色遮阳帽的外国人坐着人力车向我驶来。当该外国人靠近我时，他用一块白手帕遮住了下半张脸，我再仔细一看，发现他是我的小主人。人力车继续前行，转入弗格森路（Route Ferguson），我便看不见它了。随后我将此事报告给了索伯恩先生。”

Subject (in full) Arrest of foreigner at Chen-i

Made by ____ and Forwarded by C.D.I. Robertson

At 9.45 a.m. June 17 Mr. H. Curtis of British Nationality residing at 225 Dixwell Road came to Headquarters and made the following report.

On June 14 one of Mr. Curtis's employees named Li Ah-chao ( ____ ), who looks after Mr. Curtis's property in Chen-i ( 征儀 ) came to Shanghai to see him and stated that a foreign youth had some trouble with the Chinese police at Chen-i and was taken under escort to the Chinese City at Quinsan where on some vacant ground under the hills near the city he was tied to a tree and thrashed by the Chinese Police in the presence of a curious crowd of on-lookers. Immediately after the thrashing the youth was asked if he wanted anything to eat and in reply requested foreign food. Thereupon he was offered Chinese food which he refused. The youth was then taken to the prison at Quinsan and some few days later was removed to Nanking. In describing the youth whom he alleges he saw, Li Ah Chao, states he was dressed in Boy-scout style uniform.

Sometime later the father (probably refers to D.I. Ross) of the boy accompanied by an interpreter visited Quinsan in an endeavour to trace his son and interrogated the proprietor of a tea shop. On this becoming known to the police they warned the proprietor that in the event of any trouble arising from the information he had given he would be held personally responsible. In consequence of this threat the people at Quinsan who have knowledge of the matter maintain a discreet silence.

Mr. Curtis states that if it will assist matters he is willing to summon Li Ah-chao to Shanghai but asks that the matter be treated as confidential.

Copy sent to Mr. Blackburn.
at noon June 19. H.R.

Henry Robertson
C. D. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

事由（全称） 在征仪逮捕外国人一案

由 ____ 制作，经首席侦探督察罗伯逊（C.D.I. Robertson）转呈

1931年6月17日上午9时45分，居住于狄思威路225号的英国籍公民H. Curtis先生来到总局，作了如下报告。

6月14日，Curtis先生的一名雇员李阿超（Li Ah-chao，____），负责照管Curtis先生在征仪（Chen-i）的财产，前来上海见他，并陈述称：一名外国青年在征仪与中国警察发生纠纷，随后被押解至昆山县的中国城区；在县城附近山脚下的一块空地上，该青年被绑在树上，在中国警察的殴打下，有一群好奇的旁观者在场围观。殴打结束后，立即询问该青年是否想吃东西，他回答要求吃外国食物。于是有人提供中国食物给他，但他拒绝了。随后，该青年被带往昆山监狱，数日后又被转移至南京。在描述他所声称见到的这名青年时，李阿超称其身穿童子军式样的制服。

此后不久，该男孩的父亲（可能指侦探督察Ross）由一名翻译陪同前往昆山，试图寻找其子，并讯问了一家茶馆的店主。此事被警方知晓后，他们警告店主，若因其提供的信息引发任何麻烦，他将承担个人责任。由于这一威胁，昆山知情者对此事保持谨慎的沉默。

Curtis先生表示，如果有助于处理此事，他愿意传唤李阿超来上海，但要求对此事保密。

副本已送交Blackburn先生。
6月19日中午。H.R.

亨利·罗伯逊（Henry Robertson）
首席侦探督察

特别部门主管警官。
